Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 27
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer asserted that Eliran Glazer (CFO) was not in the C-suite at IPO and that others (e.g., Harris Beber, Shiran Nawi, Daniel Lereya) were, without verifying against authoritative IPO-era sources (e.g., the 2021 F-1/press materials). This reliance on assumptions led to a factually incorrect comparison; in reality, Glazer was CFO around the IPO, while several current executives did not hold C-suite titles then.
